title: Vapouriz Premium Blackberry & Grape E-Liquid 10ml
description: Two flavours made for each other and balanced to perfection in this delicious e-liquid from Vapouriz, this captivating combination of rich, jammy blackberries and smooth, succulent black grapes delivers a sweet rush to the senses with a delightfully smooth exhale that lets the fruit linger upon your tastebuds. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full collection of Vapouriz Premium E-Liquids and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Vape Starter Kit or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options.
